Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Haines Area Office Juneau, AK 99827

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 18, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Nicole Zeiser Haines Area Management Biologist nicole.zeiser@alaska.gov (907) 766-2830

DISTRICT 15 DRIFT GILLNET FISHERY EXTENSION

Section 15-A: will be extended 24 hours and close at 12:00 noon, Thursday, August 20, 2026, with the following restrictions:

Chilkat Inlet: will be closed north of latitude of the northernmost tip of Kochu Island at 59°09.04′ N lat;

Lutak Inlet: will be closed north of a line from White Rock at 59°18.05′ N lat, 135°31.33′ W long to a point at 59°18.73′ N lat, 135°30.16′ W long.

Section 15-C: will be extended 24 hours and close at 12:00 noon, Thursday, August 20, 2026.

Section 15-C: will remain open until further notice in the waters of the Boat Harbor Terminal Harvest Area (THA) within 2.0 nmi of the western shoreline of Lynn Canal south of the latitude of Lance Point at 58°43.95′ N lat and north of the latitude of a regulatory marker at 58°36.96′ N lat, with the following restriction:

William Henry Bay: will be closed south of 58°42.93′ N lat.

Section 15-C: the Boat Harbor THA will remain open until further notice in the waters of Boat Harbor west of 135°09.57′ W long.

The Emergency Order corresponding with this announcement is EO1S6426.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
